tools.name: encode_graph_url
tools.description:
Build an equation.io graph link, validating every row with the app's parser. Pass the COMPLETE graph in "equations": a flat array of strings, one equation or definition per string, in display order — when editing an existing graph (see decode_graph_url), include unchanged rows too.

Rows can be: equ

tools.name: decode_graph_url
tools.description: Decode an equation.io link (either the #-fragment form or the /g/ share form) into its list of equation rows, so you can edit them and build a new link with encode_graph_url. The rows use the equation.io syntax documented in the "syntax" MCP resource (also at https://equation.io/llms.txt).

tools.name: show_graph
tools.description: Display an interactive equation.io graph inside the conversation, with editable equations, sliders, pan/zoom, and 3D rotation. Use when the user asks to see or explore a graph. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: encode_graph_url, decode_graph_url · Public sink: encode_graph_url, decode_graph_url, show_graph.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: encode_graph_url, decode_graph_url · Public sink: encode_graph_url, decode_graph_url, show_graph

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
